# Vendored: shot-detection-js

Source vendored from https://github.com/Seeknetic/shot-detection-js
(commit 4e77d2d), licensed Apache-2.0.

The upstream is not published to npm and ships only unbuilt TypeScript, so its
source is copied here and imported directly (Bun runs TypeScript natively).
Its single runtime dependency, `onnxruntime-node`, is declared in the adapter's
package.json. Re-sync by re-copying `src/` from a pinned upstream commit.
